risks.risk: Missing essential parts like the bobbin case, shuttle, or foot pedal.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included components laid out.

risks.risk: The machine may be missing the foot pedal or the necessary power cord.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine running to confirm it works.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
